videos.title: H22 | Intro to COPs Concepts 29 | Texture Baking
videos.description:
All Lessons and Project Files: https://www.sidefx.com/tutorials/intro-to-copernicus-concepts/

Learn how to bake high resolution geometry details onto a low resolution mesh using the texture baking tools in Houdini’s Copernicus. You’ll explore how to adjust the baking cage, control texture resolution, and generate useful maps such as normals, ambient occlusion, curvature, and height.

You’ll also explore how to preview the baked textures on the low resolution model and export the resulting maps for use in other applications. This workflow gives artists a practical way to preserve detailed surface information while keeping geometry optimized for rendering and real time production.

analysis.summary: この動画ではSideFXのCopernicusにおけるテクスチャベイクの手順と機能について解説しています。高解像度メッシュと低解像度メッシュ、ケージメッシュを用いたノーマルマップなどのベイク処理の実演が含まれています。デフォルトのレシピノードから各パラメータの調整方法を確認できます。
